items.title: 4 Risks That Could Derail the AI Trade
items.summary: To state the obvious, the trillion-dollar, or near-trillion-dollar, valuations of  SpaceX  Anthropic, and OpenAI aren’t built on current sales or earnings.  Demand for AI applications and agents needs to grow—fast—or else the entire market has a problem.  Shortly after its initial public offering, SpaceX stock traded for about 900 times its estimated 2027 earnings, according to FactSet.
